Thankfully, I consulted another doctor later, took the  injection recently & within just 3 days the cyst had reduced by nearly 70%. That itself speaks volumes about the quality of treatment I received earlier..

Another frustrating issue was the prescription handwriting. Why is it still acceptable for doctors to write prescriptions so poorly that patients cannot even understand the medicine names? The handwriting was so unclear that even AI tools failed to read it. Later I had to message the Dr.Chetna personally on WhatsApp just to confirm the names of the medicines. This is  inconvenient for patients who order medicines online.

With folded hands, I genuinely request people to be careful & avoid risking their hair and money here. My experience has been mentally & emotionally exhausting.
